title: Advanced Guards
description: Create and manage guard NPCs that follow players and attack selected targets using simple commands.
body:
# 🛡️ GuardsPlugin

**GuardsPlugin** is a Spigot/Paper plugin that allows server owners to create and manage personal guard NPCs that can follow players, protect areas, and attack targets on command.

Built for **Minecraft 1.21.1**, this plugin is designed to be lightweight, configurable, and compatible with popular NPC systems.

### ✨ Features

Create custom guard NPCs with unique IDs

Make guards **follow players**

Command guards to **attack specific players**

Distance-based tracking and behavior

Simple and intuitive ```/g``` command system

Designed to work alongside **Citizens**

Optimized for survival and SMP servers

### 📜 Commands

```/g create <name> <skin> <id>``` – Create a new guard

```/g follow <id> <player>``` – Make a guard follow a player

```/g attack <id> <player>``` – Order a guard to attack a player

```/g delete <id>``` – Remove a guard

(Additional features and improvements planned)

### ⚙️ Requirements

**Minecraft:** 1.21.1

**Server Software:** Spigot / Paper

**Dependency:** Citizens (required)

### 🧩 Use Cases

Roleplay servers with bodyguards

SMP servers with custom protection systems

PvE or PvP environments needing NPC defenders

### 🚧 Development Status

This plugin is under **active development.**

More features such as advanced AI, equipment, health systems, and permissions may be added in 
future updates.

### ❗ Notes (Important)

This plugin does **not** provide unfair advantages outside server control

No malware, no data collection, no external connections

Fully server-side and open to extension

⚠️ This plugin requires the Citizens plugin to function. Citizens is not hosted on Modrinth and must be downloaded separately.
